summary: Even for the fixed target A=I_3 there are smooth compact cap-one product inputs with uniformly bounded smooth output densities but no common modulus of continuity: at shifts pi/s tending to zero, the output sup-difference stays at least 27/9600. BV grows at least 27s/64 and every positive Sobolev norm diverges. After cap-preserving Gaussian padding the same obstruction holds for strictly positive real-analytic Schwartz marginals: the output height remains <=pi while omega_s(pi/s)>1e-3, and at heat scale 1/s the account04/B15 heat-height theorem gives ||H_s||_infinity<=pi but ||H_s'||_1>=8s/(27sqrt(e)). This refutes only a target-uniform regularity-modulus/compactness upgrade; it does not refute the universal density-height conjecture or individual C0 regularity.
